The US has 40 trillion of debt, and rising. That debt is sustainable if and only if the two following conditions both hold, at the same time:
> it can be effectively refinanced at VERY low rates
> the fed can dilute the debt away by printing
The petrodollar made those a reality - the US could issue infinite new debt and the whole world would eat it, and more, at whatever rate. Because everyone wanted dollars, and the only way to effectively get dollars was to buy US treasuries.

While theoretically the fed controls only short term rates, in practice the signalling from the fed is what makes the market.
